QuestInfo.name: Collecting Meteorite Samples
QuestInfo.1: You ran into the Yellow M-Forcer near Omega Sector. She was willing to trust you and asked you find 5 #bMeteorite Samples#k that fell from space. You're fairly sure that you'll gain her trust back completely by doing this task...
QuestInfo.2: I gathered up the meteorite samples from the Kulan Field and gave them to Yellow M-Forcer, who was at a field around Omega Sector. Hopefully this will jumpstart the studies.

0.0: Been a while! As you can see, I've been given orders from upstairs, and I am flooded with work to do. It's getting to the point where I can't possibly do all this by myself. Ohhh... yeah, I want to ask you for a favor. Will it be okay if you can spend some time for us, the Omega Sector?

yes.0: Sweet! What I wanted to ask you to do is to collect samples of the asteroids that recently fell. Apparently, the aliens, while making their way here, landed hard, to the point of having quite a number of asteroids dropping around Omega Sector. My boss said that by collecting samples, it'll immensely help our level of science in Omega Sector.
yes.1: I've received reports of there being a lot of high-quality meteorites, which'll be useful for research, in the nearby Kulan Field. Go to Kulan Field and retrieve them. Search all the meteorites and get me 5 of the #b#t4031117##k items. I'll be waiting here, so get me those samples!

no.0: You seem to be pretty busy right now, and I can't do anything about that. However, if you find yourself some free time, please talk to me. I have so much work to do right now, that I don't even sleep these days. I'll see you around.

1.0: Ohhh, you're back! Let me see... Oooh, you really picked out the best #b#t4031117#s#k available. This should immensely help our scientific studies down the road. As a sign of appreciation, I'll give you an item that's been given to me from my bosses. Please take it.

yes.0: Thank you so much for helping me out. I know you made a mistake of helping the aliens obtain classified information, but everyone makes mistakes... I think you can be proudly considered one of us now. Bye!

item.0: There are a lot of meteorites scattered throughout Kulan Field from when the aliens landed. Search the meteors and find 5 of the #b#t4031117##k items. With those samples, we might be able to make a major breakthrough! Good luck!
